_read_me: The 10 questions of the free self-check on grader.html. Weights (w) add up to 100. 'Not sure' counts half.

questions.q: On your phone, is there a tap-to-call button near the top?
questions.how: Open your site on your phone and tap the phone number.
questions.fix: Put a big tap-to-call button at the top. It is the number one way local customers reach you.

questions.q: Can you read the text on your phone without pinching to zoom?
questions.how: Open your site on your phone.
questions.fix: Make the site mobile-first. Most local customers look you up on a phone.

questions.q: Does the address bar show a padlock, with no 'Not secure' warning?
questions.how: Look just left of your web address.
questions.fix: Turn on HTTPS. Without it, browsers warn 'Not secure' and many people leave.

questions.q: Does it open in about 3 seconds or less on mobile data?
questions.how: Turn off Wi-Fi, then open your site.
questions.fix: Shrink big photos and remove heavy add-ons so the page opens fast.

questions.q: Does the first screen say what you do and which town you serve?
questions.how: Read only what shows before you scroll.
questions.fix: Put your trade and your town in the first headline, for example 'Plumber in {city}'.

questions.q: Search your trade and your town on Google. Does your business show on the map?
questions.how: Search, for example, 'barber {city}' on your phone.
questions.fix: Claim and fill in your Google Business Profile, then link it to your site.

questions.q: Is there one clear button like 'Call now', 'Book' or 'Get a quote'?
questions.how: Look at the first screen again.
questions.fix: Pick one main action and make it a big, bright button.

questions.q: Did you get new Google reviews in the last 3 months?
questions.fix: Ask every happy customer for a review with a one-tap link or a QR card.

questions.q: Are your prices, hours and the year at the bottom up to date?
questions.how: Scroll to the very bottom of your site.
questions.fix: Update hours, prices and the year. An old date makes people think you closed.

questions.q: Can customers book or ask for a quote online, any time of day?
questions.how: Try it the way a customer would.
questions.fix: Add a simple booking or quote form so leads come in after hours too.
